$comment: How ShinyQ HQ itself was built (owner request 2026-10-15). Knowledge for the Ask the HQ chatbot only: this file is not rendered; the long form is the /build page (content/build-story.json). It becomes one knowledge chunk (`site-build`) that is always retrieved for questions about this site (`isSiteQuestion` in functions/_lib/scope.ts), and an answer to such a question cites the /build page (`SITE_BUILD_PAGE` in src/ask/pack.ts), which links `source`, the public repository. Facts only, third person, verified against the repository; never a client company (C3), a cloud resource name, a hostname or a number that is not in the repository. It covers the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates, the visitor controls, per-page URLs and ?view=classic, the secret B1 Engine Room and the Agent Office (what it shows and its privacy rule, never its live data). Update it in the same PR when the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates or the visitor controls (Rover, floors, minimap, settings, links) change. Validated by SiteBuildSchema (src/content/schema.ts) and the public-safety lint.

text.en: Kurniadi built ShinyQ HQ from October 2026 through reviewed pull requests. AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot and Claude Code) implemented written specs and plans; he owned review and merge. Stack: a Next.js 16 static export, React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl for English and Indonesian, and zod-validated content. The tower uses three.js through React Three Fiber and zustand, with full, lite or static device tiers. Motion reduces animation; the Classic site presents the same content as accessible HTML without WebGL. Hosting: Cloudflare Pages, with Pages Functions for the assistant, performance beacons and visit stats, plus KV, Analytics Engine and the hq-stats Cron Worker. Rover is a small robot guide in the 3D tower. Ask AI opens a separate chat panel, Ask Rover Assistant (internally Ask the HQ). It retrieves a curated pack of public site content, using Gemma 4 on Workers AI through AI Gateway, then Mistral Small 3.1 and Groq as fallbacks, with Turnstile, rate limits and output checks. Vitest, Playwright shards, Lighthouse CI and 3D gates check draw calls, triangles, JavaScript size and memory. Production deploys by workflow after merge, reusing green PR checks for the same tree or waiting for full main CI; red main CI rolls back. Source: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ on GitHub. Drive Rover with WASD, arrow keys or the touch joystick. Hold Shift (or double-tap the joystick) to boost to about twice the speed. Point-and-go drives to and opens glowing rooms, pads or boards: click on desktop, double-tap on touch screens. The elevator serves L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing and the RF roof deck. A first-visit tutorial and hints explain the controls (Settings replays or toggles them). The Rover menu offers room shortcuts. Tap the minimap or press N for a floor overview and destination picker. Settings also controls language, motion, graphics, day/night, minimap, sound and music. Pages have shareable URLs; in 3D, a project or floor link navigates there. ?view=classic selects the Classic site; an ordinary link follows the recipient's remembered view. Visiting all five public floors unlocks B1 Engine Room in the elevator. Its five active stations and two coming-soon bays complement the public /build page (architecture, build rounds, AI-agent workflow, quality gates, figures). The Agent Office, in its own wing of the Lobby, shows his AI coding agents live through hooks: Rovers at five desks with their state and activity type. Titles appear only for allowlisted public repositories, else "Client project"; code, prompts, file paths and client names never leave his machine. A screen wall adds public GitHub activity; when the hooks are quiet, the office is semi-live. The Classic home page shows it as the Live Agent Office card.
text.id: Kurniadi membangun ShinyQ HQ sejak Oktober 2026 lewat pull request yang di-review. AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot dan Claude Code) mengerjakan spec dan rencana tertulis; Kurniadi me-review dan merge. Stack: static export Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl (Inggris dan Indonesia) dan konten tervalidasi zod. Menara: three.js lewat React Three Fiber dan zustand, tier perangkat full, lite atau static. Motion mengurangi animasi; Situs klasik menyajikan konten sama sebagai HTML aksesibel tanpa WebGL. Hosting: Cloudflare Pages, Pages Functions untuk asisten, beacon performa dan statistik kunjungan, KV, Analytics Engine dan Cron Worker hq-stats. Rover adalah robot pemandu kecil di menara 3D. Tanya AI membuka panel chat terpisah, Asisten Rover (internal: Ask the HQ). Konteksnya dari pack terkurasi konten publik; model Gemma 4 di Workers AI lewat AI Gateway, fallback Mistral Small 3.1 lalu Groq, dengan Turnstile, rate limit dan output check. Pengujian: Vitest, shard Playwright, Lighthouse CI dan gate 3D (draw call, segitiga, ukuran JavaScript, memori). Deploy production lewat workflow setelah merge: memakai ulang CI PR hijau untuk tree yang sama atau menunggu CI main penuh; CI main merah memicu rollback. Kode sumber: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ di GitHub. Kemudikan Rover dengan WASD, panah atau joystick sentuh. Tahan Shift (atau ketuk dua kali joystick) agar melaju sekitar 2x lebih cepat. Point-and-go mengantar Rover ke ruangan, pad atau papan menyala dan membukanya: klik di desktop, ketuk dua kali di layar sentuh. Lift melayani L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing dan dek atap RF. Tutorial kunjungan pertama dan petunjuk menjelaskan kontrol (ulang atau matikan di Pengaturan). Menu Rover berisi pintasan ruangan. Ketuk minimap atau tekan N untuk ikhtisar lantai dan pilih tujuan. Pengaturan juga untuk bahasa, motion, grafis, siang/malam, minimap, suara dan musik. Tiap halaman punya URL untuk dibagikan; di 3D, tautan proyek atau lantai mengantar Rover ke sana. ?view=classic memilih Situs klasik; tautan biasa mengikuti tampilan yang diingat perangkat penerima. Mengunjungi kelima lantai publik membuka Ruang Mesin B1 di lift. Lima stasiun aktif dan dua bay coming soon melengkapi halaman publik /build (arsitektur, putaran build, alur kerja AI agent, quality gate, angka). Agent Office di sayap Lobi sendiri menampilkan AI coding agent Kurniadi langsung lewat hook agen: Rover di lima meja dengan status dan jenis aktivitas. Judul hanya tampil untuk repositori publik yang diizinkan, lainnya "Proyek klien"; kode, prompt, path file dan nama klien tak pernah keluar dari mesinnya. Dinding layar menambah aktivitas GitHub publik; tanpa agen melapor, kantor semi-langsung. Beranda Situs klasik memuatnya sebagai kartu Kantor Agen Langsung.
